tw-wi-blackhawk-jaeger-1923.st: A hidden cellar under the shack, reached by a trap door under the bed, was found and searched in Aug 1923; nothing but newspapers. No money find was reported through 1924.
src: Baraboo News Republic, 6 Aug 1923, p. 1, 'Seek Money in Cave' (Newspapers.com 868569029)
Reedsburg Times, 23 Nov 1923, p. 1 (conviction; reward dispute)
Oconomowoc Enterprise, 25 Feb 1927, p. 5 ('a little farm three miles southwest of Palmyra') (Newspapers.com 1100868014)
